title: Selector Decision (LLM portion)
description: Simplified schema for what the LLM Selector agent writes. Python pre-computes and merges all mechanical fields (chosen_plan, chosen_metrics, regressed, convergence, iteration_table, plan_results, strategy_note.prediction_analysis) AFTER the LLM writes this file. The final selector_decision.json on disk will contain all original fields — this schema only covers what the LLM must supply.

decision.description: 'continue' = promote best plan and proceed. 'stop' = halt the loop (only valid reasons: closure_achieved or all_plans_failed). 'backtrack' = re-seed from an earlier iteration. 'accept_regression' = promote a regressed plan with a different path structure. 'retry' = none of this iteration's plans beat the seed; re-seed from the same ODB next iteration.

stop_reason.description: Required non-null only when decision='stop'. 'closure_achieved' if WNS >= 0. 'all_plans_failed' if no plan ran successfully. Hard plateau is NOT a valid stop reason — use 'backtrack' instead.

backtrack_to_iteration.description: Required non-null only when decision='backtrack'. The iteration whose best ODB to re-seed from. Target the last iteration that produced meaningful ΔWNS (>=3 ps), NOT always iteration 1.

per_plan_ratings.description: One entry per plan that ran successfully. Rating: A=excellent, B=good, C=marginal, F=failed/regressed. Note: one sentence on why.

strategy_note.description: Semantic analysis passed to the Planner for the next iteration.

stuck_paths.description: Endpoint names that are the worst across 2+ consecutive iterations. Read best/best_worst_paths.txt to identify these. Empty list if no plateau or iteration 1.

plateau_diagnosis.description: 'same_bottleneck' = same cell/path stuck (try ECO, vt_swap-first, or backtrack). 'new_bottleneck' = different worst path emerged (prior repairs shifted the critical path — good sign). 'broad_stall' = TNS improved but WNS didn't (worst path is structural). null if not in plateau.

guidance.description: Actionable strategic hints for the Planner. Be specific — name stuck cell instances, exhausted sequences, untried angles. No length cap: quality of guidance directly determines next-iteration improvement.

avoid_strategies.description: Strategies tried and failed — the Planner must not repeat these. Populate especially on 'backtrack' decisions, listing everything tried from the backtrack point onward.

more_info.description: 1-2 sentences: what additional data or context would have helped you assess plans or steer the Planner better? Not parsed by infrastructure — for human review only.

x-more-info-note: The 'more_info' field is optional free text — 1-2 sentences on what additional data would have helped. Not parsed by infrastructure, for human review only.
